title: Header/footer (inside sectioning content) inside header/footer?
body:
I always ignored the validator errors telling me:

> The element `header` must not appear as a descendant of the `footer` element.

Because the [content model of the `footer` element in HTML 5.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/html52/sections.html#the-footer-element) makes perfect sense to me:

> Flow content, but with no `main` element descendants, or `header`, `footer` elements **that are not descendants of sectioning content which is a descendant of the** `footer`.

Consulting the [living standard](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/sections.html#the-footer-element) this seems no longer true.
Digging deeper I found [these](https://github.com/w3c/html/issues/1567) [issues](https://github.com/w3c/html/issues/273) that seem to confirm (@stevefaulkner) that something like this should be allowed:

```
<footer>
    ...
    <section>
        <header>
            ...
        </header>
        ...
    </section>
    ...
</footer>
```

But, I couldn't find a corresponding issue here in the WHATWG repo or any hint when, where and why [this change](https://github.com/w3c/html/pull/429/files) hade been reverted.

So, why are `header`/`footer` elements **inside sectioning content** inside a `header`/`footer` not allowed anymore? Thanks.
